content: Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) devices are categorized based on their functionality as defined by the American Diabetes Association (ADA). Real-time CGM (rtCGM) devices continuously provide glucose data in real time, allowing users to monitor their glucose levels without any manual intervention. Intermittently Scanned CGM (isCGM) devices, on the other hand, require the user to manually scan the sensor in order to obtain glucose readings.
